Ayush

Last company was a stealth ai startup that i worked on as a co founder, before that i was a product management intern at advantageclub.ai in gurugram

co-founder of a stealth ai startup... that's either the future or a very expensive learning experience. advantageclub before that - the employee benefits platform that's trying to make corporate perks actually useful.

No thats not me

/ayushg647
  Try this
Couldnt scale it up due to a slow team coordination and and very slow get to market strategy
got it. so you were building something in stealth mode... what made you decide to shut it down and start looking again?

ah the classic startup death spiral - amazing tech, terrible execution. slow team coordination is startup poison... you can have the best ai model but if your team moves like a government office, you're dead. 

sounds like you learned the hard way that speed beats perfection in early stage. how long you been working total?
1 year 3 months

1.25 years... so you jumped straight from intern to co-founder. that's either brave or slightly insane. probably both.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Product / data / business roles

product, data, business... casting a wide net. smart move at 1.25 years - you're still figuring out what you actually like vs what sounds cool.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to any city in India
